definitions.explanation: The time when night ends and day begins; the break of day.

definitions.gloss: end of a period, beginning of a new era
definitions.explanation: The point at which a period or season ends and transitions into the next phase. Used for the end of the rainy season, the new year, and similar transitions.

examples.japanese: {明|あ}けの{空|そら}が{赤|あか}く{染|そ}まっていた。
examples.english: The dawn sky was dyed red.

examples.japanese: {明|あ}けの{明星|みょうじょう}が{東|ひがし}の{空|そら}に{輝|かがや}いていた。
examples.english: The morning star was shining in the eastern sky.

examples.japanese: {梅雨明|つゆあ}けを{待|ま}っている。
examples.english: I'm waiting for the end of the rainy season.

examples.japanese: {年明|としあ}けに{会|あ}いましょう。
examples.english: Let's meet after the new year.

examples.japanese: {連休|れんきゅう}{明|あ}けは{仕事|しごと}がたまっていて{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: Work piles up after the long holiday, so it's tough.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun form of the verb {明|あ}ける (to dawn, to open). In sense 1, most commonly appears in the compound {夜明|よあ}け (dawn, daybreak). In sense 2, it forms many useful compounds:

- {梅雨明|つゆあ}け: end of the rainy season
- {年明|としあ}け: the new year, after the new year
- {連休|れんきゅう}{明|あ}け: after a long holiday
- {正月|しょうがつ}{明|あ}け: after New Year's
- {夏休|なつやす}み{明|あ}け: after summer vacation

The sense 2 pattern 〜{明|あ}け is very productive and means "right after the end of ~."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜明|よあ}け: dawn, daybreak
- {梅雨明|つゆあ}け: end of rainy season
- {年明|としあ}け: new year
- {明|あ}けの{明星|みょうじょう}: the morning star (Venus)
